detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam!
The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.
*Voiceover is only available in Japanese.

■ Story

A string of assassinations targeting mafia leaders rocks the criminal underworld, giving rise to rumors of a mysterious organization known as Inferno and its deadliest assassin, Phantom.
While on a solo trip to the United States, a teenage boy finds himself face-to-face with this so-called Phantom—only to discover that she's a girl roughly his own age.
Stripped of his memories, the boy is taken in by Phantom and trained in the art of killing. As he learns, he grows into an assassin capable of standing alongside her, and is gradually drawn into the organization's conspiracies.
In this ruthless, lawless world, what will become of the two young assassins...?

■ Characters

Zwei (Reiji Azuma) 　Voiced by: Irino Miyu
Ein/Phantom              Voiced by: Takagaki Ayahi
Claudia McCunnen    Voiced by: Hisakawa Aya
Cal Devens             　Voiced by: Sawashiro Miyuki
Mio Fujieda            　Voiced by: Koshimizu Ami
Scythe Master           Voiced by: Chiba Isshin
Lizzie Garland        　Voiced by: Watanabe Akeno
Raymond McGuire　 Voiced by: Chiba Susumu
Isaac Wisemel           Voiced by: Ishikawa Hideo

■ Game Details

▼About Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO
A Japanese tourist visiting the United States is kidnapped by a criminal organization and trained to become an assassin.
This is a neo-noir, gun-centric action story presented as a cinematic text-based visual novel.
First released for PC in 2000, it was followed by a DVD-PG version in 2001 and a PlayStation 2 release in 2003. In 2009, the TV anime "Phantom: Requiem for the Phantom," featuring additional original episodes based on the PC game's scenario, was broadcast. In 2012, an Xbox 360 version incorporating elements from the anime was released, followed by a full Windows port of that version in 2013.
*This game features the same content as the 2013 PC version.

▼Includes Elements From the TV Anime
All character designs and graphics have been updated to match the TV anime, with the same voice cast reprising their roles. Original episodes added in the anime are also included.
Whether you've played the original game, discovered the series through the anime, or are experiencing Phantom for the first time, this title provides a fresh and surprising experience for all.

▼Urobuchi Gen's Debut Work
Phantom is also the debut work of renowned writer Urobuchi Gen, known for titles such as Puella Magi Madoka Magica.

■ Game Overview

Genre　　　　　　　: Neo-noir Visual Novel
Story　　　　　　　 : Urobuchi Gen/Yasukawa Shogo/Morimiya Takashi
Character Concepts  : Yanoguchi Kimi
Character Design      : Yamashita Yoshimitsu/Sasaki Mutsumi/Kikuchi Yoko/Kado Tomoaki/Tsubata Yoshiaki/Shiba Minako
Developer           　   : NITRO PLUS
